hubs.title: Crypto & Digital Money
hubs.description: Money is moving onto new digital networks. Stablecoins, tokenized money and crypto networks: what is law, what is live, how it really works, and who controls it.

hubs.title: Banking & the Dollar
hubs.description: The old money system is being audited and rewired. The Fed, Treasury and clearing, banks and charters, your money and debt, gold and metals, and the court cases over who gets inside the system.

hubs.title: Innovation
hubs.description: New technology and science, and who's building it. AI and national science missions, national-security technology, communications, advanced materials, and the places building them.

hubs.title: Government Changes
hubs.description: The federal government is rebuilding how it runs. Federal workers and agencies, budgets and plans, government AI and records, fraud and payment controls, and the White House and Congress.

hubs.title: Energy, Data Centers & Big Projects
hubs.description: Who pays to build the power plants, data centers and factories. Power and energy, data centers and computing, and the money and investment behind big physical projects.

hubs.title: Education
hubs.description: How schools and universities are funded and controlled. University funding and controls, research security reviews, and state education policy.

hubs.title: Citizenship, Voting & Immigration
hubs.description: Who counts as a citizen, who can vote, and who can stay. The census and citizenship, eligibility for benefits, elections and the 2028 question, and deportation cases.

hubs.title: Sanctions, Oil & the Military
hubs.description: How the U.S. uses economic and military pressure. Sanctions on Iran and Cuba, oil and gas shipping routes, the military and its supply lines, and emergency and surveillance powers.

hubs.title: Foreign Relations & World Money
hubs.description: How other countries, currencies and global groups are shifting. The dollar's role abroad, currencies and the IMF, the G7, G20 and UN, and U.S. relationships with China, Russia, the UK, Japan and neighbors.

hubs.title: Released Records & Investigations
hubs.description: What official records and investigations have brought to light. COVID origins and records, the Epstein interviews, House Oversight hearings, and how official releases are put together.

hubs.title: Federal payments: the end of the paper check, Fedwire and FedNow
hubs.description: Every dated federal filing on how the government pays and gets paid: the end of the paper check, Fedwire and FedNow, the ISO 20022 switch and weekend settlement.

hubs.title: Fed accounts and bank access: dated filings
hubs.description: Dated filings on who gets into the Federal Reserve's payment system: master accounts, account-access rules, national charters and the anti-money-laundering rules that come with them.

hubs.title: Stablecoin filings: GENIUS rules, charters and reports
hubs.description: Dated federal filings on stablecoins: GENIUS Act rulemaking and deadlines, reporting forms, trust-bank charters and sanctions on token issuers.

hubs.title: Tokenization and clearing: dated filings
hubs.description: Dated filings on tokenized money and the clearing system: DTCC, FICC and CME clearing changes, tokenized deposits and Treasury-market rules.

hubs.title: Who's in line for a bank charter or Fed account
hubs.description: Who applied for a bank charter or Fed access, who got in, and who is still waiting.

hubs.title: The fine print in big banks' customer contracts
hubs.description: The consumer side of money: who really owns the debt, the brand versus the bank behind it, where credit gets offered, and what happens to your data.

hubs.title: What the states are doing with money
hubs.description: What the states are doing with money on their own: gold as money, bitcoin reserves, state stable tokens, crypto laws and new stock exchanges. Written from news reports; most entries have no source link yet.

hubs.title: AI, science and new-tech filings
hubs.description: Dated federal filings on AI and computing, biotech, self-driving vehicles and space: what the government is building and which rules it is lifting.

hubs.title: Defense R&D, drones and airspace filings
hubs.description: Dated federal filings on defense research and procurement reform, drones, air taxis and the airspace.

hubs.title: Nuclear and energy filings
hubs.description: Dated federal filings on nuclear power and energy: reactor licensing reform, NRC rules and fees, DOE reactor testing.

hubs.title: Other countries' money moves, region by region
hubs.description: How other countries are rebuilding money, region by region: tokens and stablecoins, payment plumbing, new regulatory walls, central-bank digital money and gold. Written from news reports of official moves.
